Pixel OS v1.6.4 — Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Calibrated iOS 26 Liquid Glass Defaults (20% Refraction Strength, 20% Glass Blur / Frost, 70% Wallpaper Brightness Depth): Default optical parameters and iOS Styler 'Reset Defaults' / slider calibration detents now tune out-of-the-box to crisp 20% Refraction, 20% Glass Blur, and 70% perceptual s^1.65 Wallpaper Brightness behind 100%-bright Home Screen icons across Pixel Launcher, iOS Styler, and iOS Messages
• Full 0%–100% Perceptual Wallpaper Brightness Slider (s^1.65 Gamma Depth Curve): Smoothly dims Home Screen & iOS Styler backdrops down to pure 0-nit AMOLED black (0%) with dark-adaptive obsidian frost across the Liquid Glass Dock & 'Q Search' capsule
• iCall 26 System Dialer (Phone, v1.28) + iOS 26 Liquid Glass Messages (IosMessages) + True 0% Refraction & 0% Frost Optical Crystal + 129 Bundled iOS 26 Icons
